items.q: Why does Huberman sequence ten protocols through the day instead of offering a buffet of hacks?
items.a: They **ratchet together**. Last night's sleep sets this morning's **cortisol awakening response**; that **peak buys the nighttime trough**. Zero or existing-budget cost. One rest day on training.

items.q: Is high morning cortisol the problem?
items.a: No. You want the peak **as high as possible in the first 60 minutes**. A **flat morning curve** means longer daytime stress, worse recovery, shorter life. Cortisol **mobilizes energy**; Huberman bets **2027** closes the coffin on cortisol-is-bad.

items.q: What is the morning light rule if you live under UK cloud?
items.a: **Daylight in the eyes** in hour one, **not through glass**. Overcast still counts. Miss a day → **twice as long** next day. **10,000 lux** if you wake before the sun. Skin long-wavelength light can cut a glucose peak **>25%**.

items.q: What does 'bright days and dark nights' actually change?
items.a: UK Biobank: they are **additive**. Bright nights raise **early-death** risk. After **6pm LED work at home counts as night shift**. Afternoon daylight is **Netflix inoculation** — buffers adult night screens; **it does not buffer adolescents**.

items.q: What real-time tool beat meditation, box breathing, and Wim Hof-style breathing?
items.a: The **physiological sigh** (double inhale, long exhale). **Once** is enough in the moment. **10 long exhales** if you wake at 3am. First **20–30 seconds** of stress your prefrontal cortex is offline — wait before you text.

items.q: Does turning the phone face-down fix focus?
items.a: You can still focus. **Cognitive flexibility** drops if the phone is **anywhere in the room**, even off. Get it **out of the room** for a **90–120 min** effortful bout. Adult brains rewire on **genuine ~15% errors**, not every experience.

items.q: What is Hollis's daily triad, and why is it not enough?
items.a: **Shut up** (gratitude), **suit up** (prepare), **show up** (fulfill roles). Do only that for decades and you can still be **miserable**. Once a day **exit stimulus-response**. You find a calling **while working something else**.

items.q: How does Huberman talk about God without a proof?
items.a: Faith as **infrared goggles** — pit vipers see IR; we don't, because we lack the sensors. **Thirst proves water**. He has not missed nightly prayer in nearly **3 years**. Ask for energy to do the right things, not for a cosmic favor.

items.q: Why walk 5–10 minutes after a meal?
items.a: The **soleus** is ~**1%** of muscle with **outsized glucose use**. Low-level contractions **flatten the glucose peak**. Target **7–8k steps/day**, not a 10k religion. Aging metabolism 'slowdown' is often **people moving less**.

items.q: If he could keep only five supplements?
items.a: **Magnesium** threonate/bisglycinate (if sleep is not already great), **≥1 g EPA** (Lovaza), **vitamin D 5–10k IU**, **alpha-GPC 600–900 mg** plus garlic for TMAO, **creatine 5–10 g**. Behavior is the foundation; peptides sit on top.
